# Astrolift documentation

> Astrolift is a multi-tenant control plane for applications, agents, workflows, and portable Kubernetes deployments.

Use these plain-Markdown references as the current public contract. The target installation's GraphQL schema and server-side validators remain authoritative.

## Start here

- [Choose a client](https://astrolift.dev/guides/clients/): dashboard, CLI, API, and MCP decision guide
- [Platform reference](https://astrolift.dev/reference/): reference index and versioning rules
- [Getting started](https://astrolift.dev/getting-started/): install, authenticate, register, and deploy

## Client contracts

- [CLI](https://astrolift.dev/reference/cli/): commands, auth, CI, offline docs, Markdown export, and man pages
- [Control API](https://astrolift.dev/reference/api/): GraphQL endpoint, REST boundaries, bearer auth, tenancy, and errors
- [MCP](https://astrolift.dev/reference/mcp/): Streamable HTTP endpoint, scopes, tools, resources, and protocol checks

## Declarative formats

- [astrolift.toml](https://astrolift.dev/reference/astrolift-toml/): app and workload schema, monorepos, and validation
- [Agent packages](https://astrolift.dev/reference/agent-packages/): briefs, skills, tools, payload slices, imports, and federation
- [Workflow TOML](https://astrolift.dev/reference/workflow-toml/): ordered stages, agent binding, outputs, and repo reconciliation

## Setup and final notifications

- [Capabilities](https://astrolift.dev/guides/capabilities/): discover server version, API surface, provider support, and permissions
- [App setup](https://astrolift.dev/guides/app-setup/): source registration, image deployment, health, and shared bindings
- [Agent setup](https://astrolift.dev/guides/agent-setup/): packages, environments, secret references, dispatch, and observation
- [Workflow setup](https://astrolift.dev/guides/workflow-setup/): author, validate, bind, configure, and run ordered stages
- [Reviewed starts](https://astrolift.dev/guides/reviewed-starts/): exact workflow definitions and pipeline runs, typed JSON inputs, durable request identity, read-only recovery and cancellation state
- [Shared services](https://astrolift.dev/guides/shared-services/): catalogue discovery, provision once, attach apps and agents, and inspect readiness
- [Agent completion callbacks](https://astrolift.dev/guides/agent-completion-callbacks/): signed final events, retries for 24 hours, replay, key rotation, and Python verification

## Operational guides

- [Working with apps](https://astrolift.dev/working-with-apps/)
- [Reviewed environment controls](https://astrolift.dev/guides/environment-actions/): exact-target restart, scale, shell attachment and disconnect behavior
- [Running an organization](https://astrolift.dev/running-an-org/)
- [Operator quickstart](https://astrolift.dev/operators/quickstart/)
- [Install Astrolift](https://astrolift.dev/operators/install/)

## Portable release-matched copy

The astro CLI embeds a release-matched Markdown snapshot. Run `astro docs list`, `astro docs show <topic>`, or `astro docs export <directory>`. Generated CLI Markdown and man pages come from the executing command tree.

- [Exact preview targets](https://astrolift.dev/guides/preview-targets/): Exact preview and environment GUID/version bindings, explicit runtime cost and scoped log reads.
- [Workload signals](https://astrolift.dev/guides/workload-signals/): Per-signal scope, runtime membership, instrumentation, collectors, limits and unavailable states.
